transcript: If I'm being honest, I don't think that this video of Nick Jonas singing Moving Too Fast is nearly as bad as a lot of people are making it out to be. Like, sure, there are some moments where he goes a little pop with the vocals that I didn't really love, but for the most part it sounded like a pretty standard rendition of the song. Honestly, my bigger issue with the Nick Jonas casting is just the fact that he's not Jewish. Now I am fully prepared to get hate for this take, but I will say right off the bat, I do not think that every Jewish role can only be played by a Jewish actor. Like, if you want to cast a guy as Jared Kleinman and Gareth Evans and Hanson, be my guest. And even then, there are just some non Jewish actors who are better at pulling off Jewish roles than others. People like Rachel Brosnahan, Stephanie J. Block, even Norbert Leo Butz, who originated the role and is not Jewish. But you would never know that if you saw him in the show. And so with enough talent, research, and prep, I do think it is possible for these roles to be played by non Jewish actors. However, the flip side of that is when it does fail, it has the potential to become very offensive very fast. This role specifically, I think is a really difficult to get right if you are Not Jewish. And that is because of two songs, the Shiksa Goddess and the Shmuley song. Shiksa Goddess is a song entirely about how Jamie hates dating Jewish women, while the SHMU song is deeply rooted in Jewish culture and language. And all of this to say, I am very nervous about Nick Jonas in this role specifically. If I am being candid, none of the work that he has done in the past on stage gives me much confidence that he will be able to play this role authentically and respectfully. And maybe he will prove me wrong. I am certainly open to that. But I am really nervous about it, and that has always been my concern since this casting has been announced.
